title: changelog.yaml
description: The releases of a semantic layer, oldest first, beside semantic.yaml. Append-only: an entry is added by semlayer change close and never edited. Holds approve targets, content hashes and the golden rows a golden file already holds; never a connection URL or a password.

entries.description: One entry per release; versions rise down the list.

version.description: The layer version this entry records, chosen by the owner.

note.description: What the release is for, in the owner's words.

items.description: Approve target to content hash, for every item of the layer at the release.

definitions.description: Approve target to the item's hash without its description, for each item of items that has a description, so semlayer change status can tell a description-only change. Absent in an entry recorded before descriptions were part of an approval, whose items hold those hashes.

goldens.description: Golden name to the rows recorded for it at the release, as the golden file stores them (a protected column's values included, as the golden holds them).

added.description: Approve targets new since the last entry.

changed.description: Approve targets whose hash differs from the last entry.

removed.description: Approve targets the last entry had and this one lacks.

goldens_moved.description: Goldens whose recorded rows differ from the last entry's, with cell counts.

before.description: Cells in the previous recorded rows.

after.description: Cells in the rows now recorded.

goldens_unconfirmed.description: Goldens that are drafts at this release (returned to draft with semlayer goldens unconfirm, their figures not confirmed as they stand): ones the last entry recorded, and ones the last entry left out that are still drafts with the same request. This entry leaves them out. Absent when there are none.

goldens_unconfirmed_requests.description: Golden name to the hash of its request, for each golden of goldens_unconfirmed, so a draft with the same request later reads as deferred by the owner at this release and one whose request changed does not. Absent when there are none.

goldens_removed.description: Goldens the last entry recorded whose file is gone at this release (semlayer goldens remove), so this entry leaves them out. Absent when there are none.
